items.title: Europe Handed Out €430 Million in SAF Permits Last Year — See Which Airlines Got the Most
items.summary: Europe’s support to the industry through its Emissions Trading Scheme swelled to four times 2024’s figure as the race to meet mandated blending targets gets underway.

items.title: What It Takes to Make AI Booking Work at Scale
items.summary: The travel industry is largely still testing AI bookings in controlled environments. Companies that can prove the technology works across live bookings at scale could gain a valuable head start.

items.title: Singapore’s Banyan Group Buys Newmark to Add 26 Hotels in Africa
items.summary: The owner of the Banyan Tree brand has taken a majority stake in a Cape Town safari and lodge operator. The deal is asset-light, adding fee income instead of bricks, and gives Banyan a foothold in safari and nature hospitality.

items.title: Southwest Airlines Hopes to Capture More High-Spend Customers With New Lounges
items.summary: Southwest is looking to lure in more premium customers with the new lounges and credit card it will launch next year, making Rapid Rewards more “aspirational.”

items.title: Hotel Locks Are Becoming Software as Dormakaba Buys Alliants
items.summary: Dormakaba’s Alliants deal shows how quickly hotel hardware and software are converging.

items.title: Thai Airways Expands Flight Network Across Europe and Asia
items.summary: Thai Airways’ expansion across Europe and Asia could strengthen Bangkok’s role as a regional hub, giving hotels and tour operators more opportunities to attract travelers combining Thailand with neighboring destinations.

items.title: Minor Hotels Signs First Hanoi Property, Targets 2028 Opening
items.summary: Minor Hotels is expanding into Vietnam's capital with a 310-room Avani+ property — its first move beyond a portfolio so far concentrated in the country's resort destinations, and a signal of where its next phase of Vietnam growth may be headed.
